rules.title: Santa Ana Ban on Algorithmic Rent Pricing Software
rules.citation: Santa Ana Municipal Code (Ordinance adopted March 9, 2026)
rules.quote: The purpose and intent of this [ordinance] is to protect the residents of Santa Ana from artificially inflated rental rates and unfair rent increases by prohibiting the sale, licensing and use of Algorithmic Devices
rules.summary: Santa Ana prohibits apartment owners and landlords from using automated AI software to set rental prices.
rules.effective_date_evidence: The measure passed its first vote on Feb. 17, and Tuesday's vote was the final step to officially put the ordinance into effect.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to apartment owners and landlords in Santa Ana
rules.penalty: Landlords caught using the banned software could be fined $1,000.
